_note: ANT WORK 3 voice script. id -> {who, text}. Text in [brackets] is a stage direction and is not spoken. Render: python3 tools/voices.py

c_who.text: So, uh... who are you? And why do you look like me?

c_who_r1.text: I'm Jay. ...And I was about to ask you the same thing.

c_who_r2.text: Jim brought me here. He said this was my house.

c_who_r4.text: Then one of us has a problem.

c_jim_r1.text: Outside, by his rocket. He has no idea you exist.

c_jim_r2.text: Let me guess. Yours has the spiky hair. And the bug stand.

c_jim_r4.text: Great. Two Jims. That's exactly what the universe needed.

c_clone.text: Are you a clone? Did Steve do this?

c_clone_r1.text: I don't know what I am. I didn't ask for this.

c_clone_r2.text: And Steve is gone. He has to be. Don't say his name in my house.

c_blocks_ask_r1.text: XXX5 turned the whole Earth into blocks. I was standing on it.

c_blocks_ask_r2.text: I put a nuke in that thing. It's dead. I'm still like this.

c_blocks_my.text: Don't look at me like that. The blocks aren't my fault.

c_blocks_my_r1.text: I wasn't going to say anything.

c_blocks_my_r2.text: ...Okay. I was. What happened to you?

c_blocks_my_r3.text: XXX5. It ate Mars. It almost ate Earth. I put a nuke in it.

c_blocks_my_r4.text: Then I'm glad you were there. Whoever you are.

c_story_tiny.text: An hour ago I was smaller than a germ. What did your Jim do to you?

c_story_tiny_r1.text: The moon. Then Mars. Bug shifts, twelve to one. Then a nuke.

c_story_tiny_r2.text: I lost a dog. You don't want the rest.

c_story_mars.text: An hour ago I put a nuke in a monster. What did your Jim do to you?

c_story_mars_r1.text: He shrunk me. Smaller than a germ. I lived in a pile of skin flakes with a dust mite named Larry.

c_mean.text: I don't trust you. Get out of my house.

c_done_1.text: Look. I don't know what this is. But standing here isn't fixing it.

c_done_2.text: We find Jim. Both of them. And we—

d_notmars.text: This isn't Mars. The sky is blue.

d_call_you.text: Jim? Jim, can you hear me?

d_call_him.text: Jim. Jim, it's Jay. Come in.

d_notblocky_r.text: I know. I don't know. Let's not think about it yet.

d_notblocky_me_r.text: ...I don't know what to do with that.

d_green_r.text: At least I can tell which one of us is me.

d_walk_1.text: Stay close. Walk where I walk.

d_walk_2.text: Last thing I remember is the wall. Then nothing.

d_walk_3.text: My head hurts. And I'm hungry. Really hungry.

d_walk_5.text: Nobody builds a pyramid in the middle of nowhere for nothing. There's something in there.

d_hungry.text: Well... we're hungry. So let's go, I guess.

p_dark_r.text: Follow the light. The purple one, down there.

p_walls.text: Hold on. Look at the walls.

p_walls_2.text: That's people. Tiny ones. Under bugs.

p_walls_5.text: A pig. On a throne. Whatever that is, I don't like it.

p_fruit_r.text: Glowing fruit. On a table. In a pyramid.

p_fruit_3.text: One bite. If it's bad, we stop.

p_fruit_4.text: That is not how poison works.

w_wake_3.text: [whisper] Don't look at it. Don't make a sound.

p2_c1.text: [whisper] He's getting up. Jay... he's getting up.

p2_c2.text: What is that? Get it off me! Get it OFF!

p2_c3.text: [whisper] The gate. He left the gate open.

p2_k1.text: Hey. You okay? That thing on our necks... one button and we drop.

p2_k2.text: My whole body is still buzzing.

p2_k3.text: We need a plan. A real one this time.

p2_k4.text: Wait. Do you feel that? My stomach... the fruit.

d1_2.text: On his table. In a cage. And we're not the only ones.

o_1.text: Easy. Easy. You're not dead. Not yet, anyway.

o_2.text: Name's Orrin. Orrin Pike. I was an explorer, once.

o_q1.text: How long have you been here?

o_a1.text: Three years, give or take. I stopped counting the days. Then I started again. Counting keeps you sane.

o_q2.text: How did you end up here?

o_a2.text: Same as you, I bet. A pyramid. A purple glow. A fruit nobody should eat.

o_a2b.text: I came looking for it. A legend. Turns out the legend eats you back.

o_q3.text: What does he want with us?

o_a3.text: A show. Every day he picks one of us for the bowl.

o_a3b.text: The bugs live under the table. He keeps them hungry.

o_a4.text: You shouldn't. Trust is for people who have time.

o_a5.text: Not that I've seen. But I've seen plenty try. Ask me again tonight.

o_bye_r.text: Rest while you can. He eats at noon. He watches after.

t_1.text: Hey! Hey, new guys! You got shrunk too, huh?

t_a1.text: He drops you in the bowl with a bug. You win, you live. You lose...

t_a2.text: Teo. Nine days here. That's a record for a new guy.

b_1.text: Don't. Don't talk to me. Every new face is gone in a week.

b_a1.text: Sure you are. Tell that to the bowl.

n1_1.text: [whisper] Psst. New guy. The back of your cage. Two bars are bent.

n1_2.text: [whisper] I did that, years ago, when that was my cage. Took me a month.

n1_3.text: [whisper] You want to win in the bowl? You'll need more than fists. A bone from his plate. A thorn from under that plant.

n1_4.text: [whisper] And don't touch anything metal. He sleeps light.

n_caught.text: You okay? He saw you. We try again. Quieter.

n_back.text: [whisper] You got it? Good. Get some sleep.

d2_1.text: Well. Looks like it's my turn.

d2_3.text: Don't. Just watch how it moves. Learn something.

d2_4.text: Three years. He made it three years.

d2_5.text: Jay. We are NOT dying in that bowl.

n2_1.text: [whisper] Orrin said bone and thorn. What else do we need?

n2_2.text: [whisper] Something to tie them together. And rocks. Anything I can throw.

n2_3.text: [whisper] The napkin has loose threads. And there are pebbles by the pot.

n2_craft.text: [whisper] Tie the thorn to the bone. Tight.

d3_2.text: You did it. You actually did it.

d4_1.text: That's the one that got Orrin.

d5_1.text: Both of us this time. He wants a show.

d5_2.text: The key! Jay, his key fell!

d5_s1.text: I got it. I got the key!

d5_e1.text: We have the key. Tonight, we go.

d5_e2.text: I can't feel my leg. But we have the key.

n1_6.text: [whisper] And take a splinter off your floor boards. The match he lit his candle with is still smoking down there by the cup. Light it, or you won't see a thing.

e_t1.text: [whisper] Hey! You got the key? Get us out too! Please!

e_f1.text: [whisper] ...You came back for us. Thank you.

e_k2.text: [whisper] Ah! A thread, I didn't see...

e_c2.text: Help! I can't move! Get it off me!

e_c4.text: The tablecloth! Grab it and slide!

e_c5.text: The door! Run for the light under the door!

h_1.text: Okay... that's NOT the pig room.

h_3.text: Wait. I know this place. This is my house... but it's all wrong. It's huge. And twisted.

h_2.text: That's me. Older. With a family... a normal life. No Jim, no ants. I never had that.

h_am.text: Hey babe, it's me. Bus broke down, I'll be late. Tell the kids I love 'em. Oh, and lock the cat flap, Shadow keeps sneaking out. Key's in the cookie jar. Love you. Bye.

h_5.text: The cookie jar. The cat flap. That's our way out.

h_6.text: [whisper] Is that the cat? ...Don't wake it up.

h_split.text: That hallway is huge. Split up and meet at the counter... or stick together?

h_met.text: There you are! Thought the drips got you.

h_10.text: Now down to the cat flap. Don't let Shadow see you.

h_7c.text: Oi! Big cat! Come and get me!

h_12.text: Wait... the watch. It's glowing again.

n_1.text: My collar... it's gone. The blast fried it.

n_3.text: This isn't Earth. Look at the sky.

n_4.text: The ice! Don't stop, keep walking!

n_6.text: That's not an ant. That's a building with legs.

n_7.text: Lights. Way out there. Somebody lives here.

n_8.text: And those tracks... something drove through here. Let's find shelter first.

c_1.text: Tally marks. Somebody was counting days... a LOT of days.

c_4.text: A knife. A map. And a photo of his family. He was just a guy. Like us.

c_7.text: I'm a clone, bro. I don't even get tired.

c_9.text: Found 'em. Told you the chip works.

l_1.text: Morning, sunshine. Remember me? My ship. The cuffs.

l_2.text: Don't be scared. You're safe here. It's warmer than that cave.

l_3.text: Wanna know how we found you? That watch. I put a little chip in it back when I had you on my ship.

l_q1.text: Give me back my watch or I swear...

l_a1.text: Or you'll what? You're strapped in a chair, kid.

l_q2.text: How do you even know about the watch? About Jim?

l_a2.text: Your boss Jim found it. In the sand, by his little stand. He never knew what it was.

l_a2b.text: It's not from your world, Jay. It isn't from ours either.

l_a2c.text: And it picked YOU. Lucky you.

l_q3.text: It's broken. It doesn't even work anymore.

l_a3.text: Nice try. It blasted you across the galaxy last night.

l_q4.text: Please. Just let us go home.

l_4.text: We just need to look inside your head. Everything you know about the watch.

l_5.text: Sit back. It'll feel like a nice dream. Your old job, maybe.

w_2.text: Then FIX it! I'm not losing that watch!

w_3.text: I told you it wasn't ready for two!

r_2.text: End of the road, kid. Nowhere left to run.

r_3.text: Hand over the watch and nobody falls.

r_5.text: The watch... it's doing it again!

fj_1.text: Morning, Jay! Ants are bad today. Keep 'em off the food, alright?

fj_2.text: Morning, Jay! Ants are bad today. Keep 'em off the food, alright? Huh. Didn't I say that yesterday?

fj_3.text: How's your neck? That collar left a mark, huh.

fj_3c.text: Two Jays at work! Ha! What are the odds?

fj_3d.text: Weird... you look really familiar. Have we met?

fj_4.text: The pig king says hi. ...What? I didn't say anything.

fj_4b.text: Get some rest, Jay. You've got a long run ahead of you. Over the bridge. All the way to the cliff.

fj_4c.text: Bro. Your wrist keeps buzzing. You don't even have a watch.

fj_5.text: Morning, Jay! Ants are bad today. Keep 'em off the f—

fj_5b.text: Jay... I remember. The table. The pig. The ice. None of this is real!

fj_5c.text: The chair. We're still in the chair. Come on... together!

fc_1.text: Hi! One sandwich, please. I'm new in town.
fc_1.name: CUSTOMER

fc_3.text: Do you ever feel like someone's watching you? From... above?
fc_3.name: CUSTOMER

f_fail.text: Ants got the food! Again, Jay. Do it again.
